message.text:
Checking whether Standard Webhooks is the signing mechanism and confirming the delivery package name.

`CreateMemo` in `server/router/api/v1/memo_service.go` triggers `DispatchMemoCreatedWebhook` in `server/router/api/v1/memo_service_webhooks.go`. That function calls `webhook.PostAsync(payload)` from the `github.com/usememos/memos/internal/webhook` package. HMAC-SHA256 signs requests using Standard Webhooks headers.

`webhook.Post` performs the actual HTTP delivery inside `internal/webhook`. Checking go.mod and tests to confirm whether the Standard Webhooks signing logic is in-house or uses an external library.

message.text:
The answer is ready. I am formatting it now.

`DispatchMemoCreatedWebhook` in `server/router/api/v1/memo_service_webhooks.go` dispatches memos. The HTTP delivery package is `github.com/usememos/memos/internal/webhook`. Request signing uses HMAC-SHA256 with `webhook-id`, `webhook-timestamp`, and `webhook-signature` headers.
